name: Exepad
short_desc: Self-hosted AI app builder — prompt to deployed full-stack app
description: Exepad turns a prompt into a real, deployed web app. A multi-agent AI builder plans the app, writes the React UI, models the data, and wires it together — compiled, deployed, and served inside one container. Bring your own LLM key (Gemini, Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, or a local model via Ollama). Needs >= 2 GB RAM; single instance only (SQLite). All state lives in the app data directory.
author: Exepad

form_fields.label: LLM API key (required to build apps; can also be set later in /settings)
